QUOTE: `edge_class` | `call` (synchronous, same thread) or `key` (shared-key dataflow, no call) ... "`callers` mixes in non-calls. `edge_class='key'` rows are writers of a shared key that the function reads."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says callers/callees rows mix direct calls and shared-key dataflow edges, distinguished by an `edge_class` field. It also says to filter on that field to get only calls.
